shortcut.openfindandreplacemenu.note: ledger feature shortcut.openfindandreplacemenu (token ctrl+h) — document-scoped handler (editor.js:10825) calls openFindDialog(true): same #find-dialog as Ctrl+F, with the replace field (#find-replace, index.html:3019) in the panel

shortcut.opencommentspanel.note: ledger feature shortcut.opencommentspanel — editor-scoped handler (editor.js:11016) calls openCommentsPanel() which clears hidden on #comments-panel; .side-panel[hidden]{display:none} vs .side-panel{display:flex} (style.css:2130). pre 'list' guarantees #editor focus for the editor-scoped keydown

shortcut.openhelpmenu.note: ledger feature shortcut.openhelpmenu — F1 (no modifiers) runs openDlg('help-dialog') (editor.js:11063); real chord verified in editor.js, matching the ledger wo match 'F1 opens Help dialog'

shortcut.opencontextmenu.note: ledger feature shortcut.opencontextmenu — Shift+F10 makes Chromium synthesize a contextmenu DOM event on the focused #editor; WO's editorEl contextmenu listener (editor.js:9750) shows #ctx-menu. pre 'list' focuses #editor so the synthesized event targets it

shortcut.closemenu.note: ledger feature shortcut.closemenu (token escape) — Escape runs closeAllMenus() -> hideBackstage() (editor.js:10728, 10506): the open #backstage-overlay (.open -> display:flex, style.css:2520) drops back to display:none. Contract asserts the menu that WAS open is closed, not that nothing opens

shortcut.zoom100.note: ledger feature shortcut.zoom100 — editor-scoped handler (editor.js:11218) resets zoomLevel=1 through applyZoom; runs after statusbar.btn-zoom-up (manifest 238) so persisted zoom is already 1 and stays 1 through Ctrl+0

shortcut.zoomin.note: ledger feature shortcut.zoomin — Ctrl+= (ev.code Equal, editor.js:11206) adds 0.1 through applyZoom from the clean persisted zoom 1; no post: the runner clicks post BEFORE asserting, so a reset post would zero the observation. The next contract (shortcut.zoomout) carries the #btn-zoom-reset post that restores zoom 1

shortcut.zoomout.note: ledger feature shortcut.zoomout — REAL GAP: the editor-scoped handler intercepts plain Ctrl+Minus earlier for the en-dash insert (editor.js:10987, '(OO convention; takes precedence over browser zoom-out)') and returns, so the Ctrl+Minus zoom-out arm (editor.js:11205) is unreachable via the physical Minus key; zoom stays 1 instead of 0.9. post #btn-zoom-reset keeps the persisted wo-zoom clean for downstream contracts

shortcut.openchatpanel.note: ledger feature shortcut.openchatpanel — editor-scoped handler (editor.js:11033) emitCommand('toggleChat') -> toggleChat() (editor.js:6676) unhides #chat-panel and flips #btn-chat-toggle aria-expanded false->true (index.html:759). attr equality avoids the absence-of-hidden gap viewport-flag cannot express
